title: Electrical Landlord Systems
activity: Switchgear, generator, PV, EV charging, lightning protection
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: LV switchgear installed, labelled, doors fitted, no damage?
Are EV chargers and PV panels installed and inspected (with their test sheets)?
Is the lightning protection installed and tested?
Generator tested to its test plan?
Ask the fitter: What labelling and test records will be in the board? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

notOk.t: Swarf in distribution boards; covers and blanks missing
SWA glands not straight, bending radius too tight
Tray twisted, loose or not square
Lightning tape visible, loose or not to the agreed detail

ask.q: Which board feeds this and is it labelled?
ask.a: They can name the board and circuit – labels match the schedule.

ask.q: Has it been tested, and who holds the certificate?
ask.a: Yes – test sheets with the supervisor.
